analysis_prompt:
Write a complete spoiler analysis of Sintel (2010), a standalone film, for a diagnostic reader who consents to all spoilers. Use all nine substantive sections, in order: 1 Summary; 2 Plot and ending; 3 Meaning; 4 Details and references; 5 Creation; 6 Characters; 7 Visual language; 8 Theories; 9 Sources. Cite evidence IDs. Explain causal links and the ending; avoid empty headings. Interpretations/hypotheses must explain their factual basis. Say when evidence is missing, especially external references and author intent. Do not make whole-film camera/editing claims from three stills. Plain prose, not JSON.

Verified evidence, checked 2026-10-29; English paraphrases by evaluator, not model extraction:
S1 (Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sintel): Sintel is ambushed in snowy mountains, defeats the attacker and takes his spear. A shaman shelters her. In flashback, she was a homeless loner who healed an injured baby dragon and named him Scales. An adult dragon captured him. She searched for many years. The shaman identifies dragon lands from the spear glyph; she finds the depicted tree and a nearby cave. Inside are an adult dragon and a baby. The baby flees; the adult attacks, then pauses on recognizing Sintel's scent. She stabs him in the heart, then recognizes Scales' wing scar before a further killing blow. He dies. Her reflection in his blood reveals gray hair, wrinkles and scars: both have aged during her long search, which she failed to understand. The cave collapses; she escapes, mourns and leaves. Scales' baby follows her.
S1 also: code-name Project Durian; third Blender open movie; produced by Ton Roosendaal, written by Esther Wouda, directed by Colin Levy, art direction David Revoy; made at Blender Institute using Blender. Work began May 2009; festival release 27 September 2010, online 30 September 2010. Community donations, DVD pre-sales and sponsorship helped fund it; film and production data released under Creative Commons Attribution. Dutch 'sintel' can mean cinder/ember. No specific external-film reference or creator statement of meaning is supplied.
S2 (Blender Studio, https://studio.blender.org/characters/5d403c21ee3219164b952e20/v2/): official metadata calls the adult Scales a character from Sintel.
S3 (Blender Studio, https://studio.blender.org/projects/sintel/): official synopsis describes a girl's friendship with a baby dragon and desperate efforts after losing it.
